description_en: Creates or updates a metadata profiling task by using a skill, configures the target component, profiling schema, profiling type, and rules, and returns the profiling task ID
description_zh: 通过 Skill 创建或更新元数据探查任务，配置目标组件、探查 Schema、探查类型与规则，返回探查任务 ID
kebab_example: aliyun lhm skill-add-meta-profiling-job --component-id 2001 --job-desc '每日全量元数据探查任务' --job-id 100256 --job-name profiling_daily --meta-ids 1001 --plugin-id profiling-plugin-001 --profiling-flag 1 --profiling-permission 1 --profiling-rule basic --profiling-schema-list ods --profiling-type 1 --api-version 2025-01-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SkillAddMetaProfilingJob

parameters.help_en: The component ID, which is the primary key identifier of the data source component
parameters.help_zh: 组件 ID，即数据源组件的主键标识
parameters.name: component_id

parameters.example: 每日全量元数据探查任务
parameters.help_en: The description of the profiling task
parameters.name: job_desc

parameters.help_en: The name of the profiling task
parameters.name: job_name

parameters.help_en: The list of metadata object IDs to be profiled or operated on
parameters.help_zh: 需要进行探查或操作的元数据对象 ID 列表
parameters.name: meta_ids

parameters.help_en: The profiling plugin ID, which specifies the plugin used to perform the profiling
parameters.help_zh: 探查插件 ID，指定执行探查所使用的插件
parameters.name: plugin_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable data profiling
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启数据探查的标识
parameters.name: profiling_flag

parameters.help_en: The list of schemas to be profiled
parameters.help_zh: 需要执行探查的 Schema（库）列表
parameters.name: profiling_schema_list

schema.description_en: The creation or update result of the profiling task returned by the API operation
schema.description_zh: 接口返回的探查任务创建/更新结果

data.description_en: The ID of the created or updated metadata profiling task
data.description_zh: 创建或更新后的元数据探查任务 ID

errCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is an empty string if the call is successful
errCode.description_zh: 错误码，调用成功时为空字符串

errMessage.description_en: The error message. This parameter is an empty string if the call is successful
errMessage.description_zh: 错误信息，调用成功时为空字符串
errMessage.example: The parameter is invalid or missing.

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues for this call
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查本次调用问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure. If the call fails, troubleshoot the issue based on the errCode and errMessage parameters
success.description_zh: 调用是否成功：true 表示成功，false 表示失败，失败时结合 errCode 与 errMessage 排查
